entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: God overrules all the plans of earthly rulers, be they righteous or wicked, for the accomplishment of his own wise and good designs.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: God will not accept the outward forms of religion as a substitute for its inward spirit, "judgment, mercy, and faith."

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: The ploughing of the wicked; their tillage; put here for all their plans, pursuits, and pleasures.  Or, "the light of the wicked," means that in which they glory.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments:
The diligent; who seek wealth by honest industry. 
 
  Hasty; impatient to amass wealth, and therefore employing unlawful means.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments:
A vanity tossed to and fro; an empty and unstable possession.  Some render, A fleeting breath, which gives the same idea. 
 
  Seek death; take the way to death. 
 
Treasures obtained by fraud and falsehood conduct their owner down to perdition, and there forsake him.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments:
Strange; alienated from God. 
 
  The pure; in contrast with the mass of mankind, whose way is froward and strange.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: A wicked man cannot be trusted where his own private interests are concerned; for he will not scruple for his own ends to sacrifice his neighbor's property, comfort, reputation, morality, and everlasting welfare.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: Wisely considereth; derives lessons of instruction from God's dealings with it.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: We all need mercy at the hand of God: but we shall not obtain it unless we show pity to our fellow men; for with the merciful, God will show himself merciful.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: Remain in the congregation of the dead; be numbered and dwell with the dead.  Compare

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: Luxurious living is the highway to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: Shall be a ransom for the righteous; God will make the destruction of the wicked a means of salvation to the righteous, as is illustrated in the deliverance of Israel from Egypt.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: When poverty comes from prodigality it is as ignominious as sinful.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: The desire of the slothful; his longing desire for good that cannot be obtained without labor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: The righteous; who has gained an abundance by honest toil.  Compare

. 
 
The righteous man values property and labors for it chiefly because of the means which it furnishes of doing good to his fellow men.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments:
Heareth; has an obedient and teachable spirit, which includes in itself the love of truth. 
 
  Speaketh constantly; while "the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped," he shall speak constantly with favor and credit.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments:
Hardeneth his face; rejects all counsel, and obstinately follows his own corrupt desires. 
 
  Directeth his way; bestows serious consideration upon it, that it may be conformed to God's law.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: The Lord has all the resources of heaven and earth at his disposal, and he can with infinite ease accomplish his own purposes in the face of all opposition from wicked men and fallen spirits; nay more, he can make their efforts to defeat his counsels the direct means of fulfilling them.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: Without God's favor the most formidable warlike preparations will be of no avail.
